calibration.population: first occurrence of each distinct complete training-batch hash in absolute steps 1..1000
calibration.selection: uniform without replacement, draw order; first 16 half 0, last 16 half 1
calibration.precision: FP32, TF32 disabled, eval mode, native hard routing/capacity/gates
calibration.objective: mean task CE only; each complete batch equally weighted; no auxiliary loss

scores.sign_consistency: max(positive,negative)/nonzero(w*g); undefined if zero nonzero products
scores.accumulation: FP64 Welford plus independent FP64 half sums; no batch-gradient archive
scores.population: expert fc1/fc2 weights only; no exposure normalization

reliability.candidate_pool: stable magnitude sort then bottom floor(N/2), flat coordinate tie break
reliability.rank: Spearman average ranks (ties averaged), undefined for constant vectors
reliability.groups: top/bottom ceil(25% of stratum), descending/ascending score then flat index ties
reliability.overlap: intersection size / group size between halves
reliability.cross_half: groups chosen on one half scored on the other, both directions
reliability.cross_separation: H>0 and H>=2*L in both directions
reliability.failure: STOP before matching/intervention/training; no calibration expansion or score changes

matching.pool: bottom half per tensor, 50 equal-count magnitude strata; only reliability-eligible tensors
matching.algorithm: Within each row, sign and magnitude stratum: visit high scores descending/flat-index tie break; choose unused lower score with H>=2L and H>0 minimizing summed squared normalized feature differences. Ties low flat index. Pair coordinates removed from future consideration. Each pair is directed edge column(H)->column(L). Deterministic DFS column ascending, outgoing edges feature cost then coordinate; extract edge-disjoint directed cycles. Keep whole cycles in discovered order up to target, skipping cycles exceeding remaining budget. No other matching repair.
matching.growth: OLS of abs(w) at 250,500,1000; tensor RMS normalization at 1000
matching.rows: exact H/L counts at every row
matching.columns: exact H/L counts at every column
matching.feasibility: exclude tensor if fewer than 656 pairs or any final check fails; require >=80% tensors per seed, >=26/32 per layer/projection, and >=0.5% all expert coordinates per branch in every seed; otherwise STOP before intervention losses. No adaptive calipers.
matching.topology_limit: Equal degrees do not fix exact connectivity; no full topology-control claim
matching.seal: all five coordinate lists and hashes immutable before any intervention CE

continuation.batch_stream: exact native original complete training batches
continuation.optimizer: fresh AdamW all parameters; canonical source lr, decay, clipping; fresh CUDA GradScaler
continuation.precision: canonical FP16 autocast/GradScaler; native auxiliary task objective/routing/capacity
continuation.rng: seed_everything(source_seed) after construction and all diagnostics, identical per branch
continuation.mask: zero selected coordinates, gradient hooks, post-update zeroing; all surviving parameters trainable
continuation.control_reuse: Only after exact source/data/code/precision/evaluation/reset/accounting audit and three-update state equality; else new C. Historical uninterrupted endpoint forbidden
continuation.schedule: pilot seed17 numerical/execution gate, retain pilot; then seeds7,29,43,61 regardless of effect sign
continuation.execution: Viper/Adder unique attempts, lock/heartbeat, atomic status, failures preserved; no automatic retries; abort nonfinite loss or >100 AMP skips

endpoints.validation: identical original full validation batch structure (including original final partial batch), task-only FP32 TF32-off, actual-token weighted
endpoints.first_order: sum S removed versus actual mean calibration CE change; validation change separate; sum A never a signed prediction

numerics.finite_difference: After all masks sealed: first two calibration batches, expert0 fc1/fc2 in each layer, max abs task gradient among bottom-half coordinates; FP64 native clone central differences at eps=[0.01,0.001]*tensor RMS; primary scoring remains FP32. Record FP32/FP64 and +/- routing identities. Boundary cases undefined, never relaxed. Require >=8 away-boundary informative comparisons and every layer represented, rtol=.05 atol=1e-7; abs analytical derivative<1e-7 uninformative.
tests: full vs streamed Welford and scores
mask counts and disjointness and balance
persistent zeros and surviving gradient flow
numerics.stage_policy: No masking, finite differences, validation or training on reliability failure; downstream tests explicitly NOT_RUN

analysis.replication_unit: source seed, n=5 intended; no weight/expert/batch pseudoreplication
analysis.constraints: No novelty claim, causality/routing mechanism claim, equivalence claim, reversed rule, extra scores, sweeps or full pruning policy
